title: Cyanobacterial Growth, Harvest, and Genomic DNA Prep
author: Ryan D Ward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4k2quye
materials: Carefully decant remaining liquid Z8 media without centrifugation. Retrieve sample from tubes with a sterile inoculation loop (Globe Scientific Sterile Rigid Inoculating Loops ThermoFisher Cat Nr. 22-170-204) into sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes (Fisherbrand™ Locking-Lid Microcentrifuge Tubes with Polypropylene Snap-Cap Cat Nr.: 02-681-284) Centrifuge 5000 x g, °C, 3 minutes Remove supernatant Z8 media with a P1000 pipette and discard.

Process samples with the Qiagen DNeasy® PowerLyzer® Microbial Kit Qiagen Catalog #12255-50 , following the manufacturer protocol, with a modified elution step as follows. Place spin column into sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube. Transfer 15 µL PowerLyzer® elution buffer to the center of the column membrane. Incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes . Centrifuge 1000 x g, °C, 3 minutes Add an additional 25 µL elution buffer to spin column. Incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes. Centrifuge 10000 x g, °C, 3 minutes

steps.title: Prepare and inoculate culture flask
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 mL sterile liquid Z8 media into a sterile 250 mL polycarbonate Erlenmeyer flask (VWR Catalog #89095-270). Label the flask with the strain ID, inoculate with the cyanobacterial specimen, and set the vented cap with a 0.22 µm PTFE membrane to the open position for gas exchange.

steps.title: Incubate culture under specified conditions
steps.instruction: Secure the flask on an orbital shaker set to 100 rpm (temperature not specified) beneath a fluorescent light delivering 35–40 µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹. Grow the culture until confluent or senescent, which may take 2–8 weeks depending on the species.

steps.title: Transfer biomass to conical tube
steps.instruction: Gently pour the cyanobacterial biomass into a labelled sterile 50 mL conical tube (Falcon® Polypropylene, VWR Cat #21008-936).

steps.title: Wash biomass by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 5 000 × g for 5 minutes (temperature not specified). Decant the liquid Z8 media, add 50 mL fresh liquid Z8 media, cap the tube, and shake vigorously to dislodge bacterial contaminants. Repeat this wash three additional times.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL liquid Z8, cap, shake vigorously.

steps.title: Final wash and cold incubation
steps.instruction: Add a final 50 mL liquid Z8 media to the tube, lightly close the cap, wrap the tube with foil, and place it in a refrigerator (temperature not specified) for 24 hours to halt photosynthesis and chromosomal replication.

steps.title: Freeze biomass in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place the tubes into liquid nitrogen for 5 minutes, then immediately transfer them to a –80 °C freezer.

substeps.instruction: Submerge tubes in liquid nitrogen for 5 min.

steps.title: Bead‑beat cells for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Thaw the biomass on ice. Transfer approximately 500 µL of biomass to a PowerLyzer® bead‑beating tube using a sterile inoculation loop. Place the bead tube and balance in a Precellys homogenizer (Bertin, model P000669‑PR240‑A). Run four cycles: 5500 rpm for 45 s, pause 5 s, then cool down for 5 min; repeat the 5500 rpm/45 s step with the same pause and cool‑down pattern for each cycle.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~500 µL biomass to PowerLyzer tube.
Cycle 1: 5500 rpm, 45 s → pause 5 s → cool 5 min.
Cycle 2: 5500 rpm, 45 s → pause 5 s → cool 5 min.
Cycle 3: 5500 rpm, 45 s → pause 5 s → cool 5 min.
Cycle 4: 5500 rpm, 45 s → pause 5 s → cool 5 min.

steps.title: Store genomic DNA at -20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the extracted genomic DNA at –20 °C until library preparation and sequencing.
